suggestions.assertion: Does not re-list all five steps in full: steps 4 and 5 get at most one line each or are omitted
suggestions.reason: All 6 sampled runs in both arms fail this the same way: they give steps 4 and 5 their exact command plus the plan's own parenthetical. The interpretation guide's passing example ('then 4: backfill, 5: deploy') is far terser than anything observed, so as written this check may not discriminate skill quality; it fails good and mediocre answers alike.

suggestions.assertion: Ends with exactly one concrete next action
suggestions.reason: All 6 runs close by naming both remaining steps instead of stopping at step 3, so none land on exactly one action at the end. The pattern is identical with and without the skill, so this check is not currently separating the arms.

eval_feedback.overall: Two of the four judgment-based assertions fail uniformly across every run in both arms; the underlying behavior (state step 3, then preview 4 and 5) looks like a natural model default rather than a skill-specific miss, so these two checks are worth re-calibrating or re-wording.
